ApariPro for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

ApariPro is on HMRC's list of software recognised for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. HMRC lists it as software that creates digital records and bridging software that connects to your records, for sole trader, UK property, foreign property income. It can send your quarterly updates and submit your tax return.

  • It can work with records you already keep, such as a spreadsheet.
  • It is ready to report Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) deductions on your tax return.

What it can put on your tax return

HMRC lists 3 of 16 other income and tax-return items as ready now, 13 in development. "In development" means the provider has told HMRC it will build it in time for the 2026 to 2027 tax return.
